desc: Convert TeX DVI file to PDF using ghostscript and dvips
r: dvipdf - Convert TeX DVI file to PDF using ghostscript and dvips

This script invokes dvips(1) with the -q option, and pipes its output into gs(1) with the following options:


-q -dNOPAUSE -dBATCH -sDEVICE=pdfwrite

as well as -sOutputFile and any options from the command-line.
This document was last revised for Ghostscript version 9.54.0.
